subject.title: fix(msteams): emit native cjs runtime entrypoints

question: Should `openclaw.build.runtimeFormat` become the supported internal opt-in for publishable plugin package module format?
rationale: The implementation is sound, but the new field establishes a reusable package metadata contract whose permanent ownership and supported scope require maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt the opt-in contract
options.body: Keep ESM as the default and approve `runtimeFormat: "cjs"` for packages such as Microsoft Teams with focused build and package verification.

options.title: Move format selection elsewhere
options.body: Use an existing release registry or package-specific build seam instead of expanding package build metadata.

options.title: Keep runtime packages ESM-only
options.body: Decline native CJS package output and address Microsoft Teams startup through another runtime mechanism.

recommendation.title: Adopt the opt-in contract
recommendation.body: Keep ESM as the default and approve `runtimeFormat: "cjs"` for packages such as Microsoft Teams with focused build and package verification.

likelyOwner.reason: The current package-runtime builder and Microsoft Teams package metadata history make him the strongest available owner for this contract decision.
